what: d1-3B: the iPhone's decoder (int8mlp S = 64, the AOT asset of gate-d1-3b-readout.json's iphone_int8mlp) on the held-out set (120 transfer-v4 records after the fixture's slices, their own oracle run), the same bar; no red arms (their base rows are fixture records) (round 11). The held-out set checks the int8 choice made on the fixture; the fp16 decoder needs no such check. compare_with = the fp16 S = 16 decoder on the same rows (round 5c).

removed: per-call ms lists (call_ms, first_call_of_process_ms; each transcript keeps its medians)
hidden-dump file names and hashes (npz, npz_key, npz_sha256, hidden_npz) and the hidden rows' lowest positions
the oracle's probabilities inside the transcripts (probs_oracle: they are in fixtures-d1-3b.json)
token ids and rendered prompt text (row_ids, ids, text, instructions, state, criteria)
other sessions' processes seen by the drivers (other_gpu_processes*, other_gpu_jobs*, busiest, top)
compare_with.rows (per-row numbers against the fp16 S = 16 run)
trimmed.full_copies: the source files above, in the lane directory $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_d1_3b/ (not in the repository)
trimmed.paths: local paths rewritten: the lane directory as $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_d1_3b, the repository relative, the home directory as ~, the checkpoint snapshot as <snapshot>, the overlay venv as <overlay venv>, temporary directories as $TMPDIR, Xcode as $DEVELOPER_DIR, the phone's app container as <app container>, the phone's ids as <udid> / <coredevice id>

readout.gate: the decoder alone on the Mac GPU (the oracle's row ids), the fp16 slot hidden read out through host.py

compression.excluded: fp32: the four attention projections of every full-attention layer; fp16: the conv-mixer projections (conv.in_proj / out_proj), the embedding table (the tied table of head/option_rows), the conv1d, every RMSNorm, SDPA
compression.head: none in the graph (the tied rows of the readout ids are head/option_rows)

bar.argmax: every question with an oracle top-2 margin above 0.02; near-ties listed apart
bar.max_abs_dp_applies_to: every option of every question, near-ties included
bar.mean_of_run_mean_abs_dp_definition: mean over runs (one run = one row = one question) of the mean |dp| over that question's options
bar.reset: every process re-runs its first row last: hidden rows bit-equal
bar.finite: every hidden value of every row finite, no row all zero

environment.runtime: coreai python runtime, AOT h16c GPU .aimodelc, SpecializationOptions.default(), no JIT
environment.readout: host.py: z = h_slot . E[id] in float64 over the group ids (head/option_rows, fp32), group max, softmax over the options
environment.gpu: shared with other sessions, _GPU_LOCK read only (the ms are contended reference values)

readout.note: round 11 step 1: the ship form int8mlp S=64 (dynamic efr AOT h16c) on the held-out set (120 records, verification only); no red arms (their base rows are fixture records)

contract.dynamic: -1 = dynamic: position_ids [1, seq] with seq in S..max_context_length-1; the KV sequence axis 2048..max_context_length (a host allocates it at max_context_length)
